visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with an exterior view of a modern glass building in Harajuku, featuring a large white 'Harry Potter' logo above the entrance. Trees with green leaves frame the sidewalk where cars pass by in the foreground under bright daylight. (2) Moving indoors, a detailed shot shows rows of 'Character Wands' displayed in vibrant gold, purple, and green rectangular boxes on dark shelves. A circular counter is surrounded by a group of diverse customers in casual clothing, including women in summer dresses and men in t-shirts, browsing the items. (3) The camera captures close-ups of themed merchandise, including white mugs wrapped in Hogwarts-striped knitted scarves, plush teddy bears wearing Hogwarts sweaters, and small Dobby figurines in clear display boxes. (4) A whimsical 'Mini Mystery Candy Store' section is shown with mint-green shelving units filled with pink and yellow jars, contrasted against a bold black-and-white checkered floor. (5) On the ceiling, numerous envelopes appear to be flying in mid-air, while shelves below hold 'Daily Prophet' postcards and authentic-looking Quidditch brooms. (6) The 'Butterbeer' area features a large wooden barrel and shelves stocked with brown glass bottles; a hand is seen holding a colorful Butterbeer-themed bottle opener. (7) A life-sized Buckbeak statue stands in a fenced display, and the escalator area is decorated like a forest with artificial trees and white owls suspended from the ceiling while people travel between floors. (8) The final shot returns to the storefront entrance where a staff member in a red uniform stands near the glass door as customers enter.
